title: Portable Trusted Linux
summary: Portable Trusted Linux is now focused exclusively on completing Prototype 1: a Debian 13/trixie portable environment with authenticated boot artifacts, TPM measured-boot evidence, dm-verity protected root integrity, disposable writable state, structured attestation and an independent verifier. Community Compute Commons research is preserved but paused until the core trust-chain acceptance gates pass.

sections.title: Current focus
sections.content: All active engineering is focused on Portable Trusted Linux Prototype 1. Community Compute Commons is retained only as paused research and will not consume implementation effort until the core security acceptance gates pass.

sections.title: Core trust chain
sections.content: Authenticated release reference -> verified USB image -> UEFI/Secure Boot -> measured boot and TCG event log -> TPM PCR evidence -> signed UKI -> authenticated dm-verity root -> immutable Linux -> RAM-backed disposable state -> nonce-bound TPM Quote -> independent verifier -> attestation report.

sections.title: Current engineering state
sections.content: The repository contains the Prototype Build Specification, host preflight, dependency installer, live-build preparation/build scripts, artifact manifest tooling, static tests, attestation schemas and verifier design. No destructive USB-writing step has been enabled yet.

sections.title: Immediate evidence gate
sections.content: The next unknown is no longer architectural. We need a real Debian 13/trixie amd64 builder to execute the repository checks. build/05-first-run-report.sh now collects the exact machine, OS, Git, toolchain, storage, memory, CPU, UEFI and TPM exposure evidence needed for the next engineering decision.

sections.title: Mandatory lessons discipline
sections.content: Every meaningful session updates docs/07-lessons-learned.md and affected specifications or decisions. project_content.json is always written last. This session recorded the decision to pause Community Compute Commons and the addition of a one-command first-builder evidence report.

decisions.title: Reuse mature security components
decisions.text: Use Debian, UEFI Secure Boot, systemd UKI, TPM 2.0 and dm-verity rather than inventing replacement primitives.

decisions.title: Independent verification is mandatory
decisions.text: The target computer cannot be the sole authority deciding that its own measurements are trustworthy.

decisions.title: GitHub is the canonical development workspace
decisions.text: Documents, source and the living JSON index are versioned in the private repository.

decisions.title: Lessons learned are mandatory output
decisions.text: Every meaningful engineering/research session records lessons before project_content.json is updated last.

decisions.title: Prototype 1 baseline is Debian 13/trixie amd64
decisions.text: Exact build-host and package versions are captured as provenance.

decisions.title: Community Compute Commons paused
decisions.text: The research remains preserved, but active implementation returns exclusively to the Portable Trusted Linux core trust chain until its initial acceptance gates pass.

decisions.title: First real-machine evidence becomes the next gate
decisions.text: Use build/05-first-run-report.sh to collect consistent evidence from a clean Debian 13/trixie amd64 builder before changing later build stages.
